work.author: Pius  episcopus  Servo*  servorum  Dei
work.description: DCCII: full In supremo apostolatus nine-section constitution, complete reciprocal parish/territory lists, financial reservations and execution clauses, transumpt, sanctio and final datum LF35868–35872. Whole candidate LF35597–35880 and 20 LF context read. Its displaced date/proem margin LF35561–35569 is retained; following DCCIII date LF35875–35880 is excluded. XML leaves266–268 substantive L/R order preserved, including sanctio continuation prae-/sumpserit across leaves. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
